main.message:
Merge PR204: release verified Atlas Map 2.0 consolidation

Publish the reviewed 48-sector / 20-Wild-Zone map-selection release, preserved source-qualified encounters and 42 written routes. Exact-head map, article and feedback CI passed; final phone/desktop screenshots and preservation review passed. Original Workspace publication remains a separate validated step.

evidence_method: Fresh complete open-PR listing and exact-main Git commit/tree from GitHub, then read-only historical Git objects and blob comparisons. No tests, branch switches, writes to checkouts or remote mutations. Ancestry checks were restricted to main first parent7616af2; selective integration findings rely on exact-main file and content evidence rather than claiming these open heads were merged.

pull_requests.title: Cross-check Wild Zone 14 against the original map photos
pull_requests.finding: The WZ14 source note is an exact blob on main. Its original corroboration scope did not itself approve geometry; later approved selection outlines use separate evidence.

pull_requests.title: Complete Vivace’s two salon side missions
pull_requests.finding: Mission51 source card is exact. Mission12 retains the reviewed rewards and individual-colour presentation correction; source cards are present in generated and standalone views.

pull_requests.title: Link the HOME forms guide to the current Vivillon gift
pull_requests.finding: home-connection.html is byte-identical to this PR head. This audit does not newly reverify the external gift distribution date.

pull_requests.title: Fix collectible search by displayed label and exact Wild Zone
pull_requests.finding: atlas-collectibles.mjs and its unit-test file are byte-identical; later UI/browser changes are preserved.

pull_requests.title: Clarify two sludge routes and the Mission 19 Ice Beam shortcut
pull_requests.finding: The research JSON and Markdown are exact; both sludge notes and Mission19 Vanillite Lv.35/Change Moves guidance are on main.

pull_requests.title: Atlas — Research seven more Wild Zone TM routes
pull_requests.finding: All seven proposed item IDs are in the current20-record written TM register; unique caveats remain archived. Exact pickup coordinates remain unapproved.

pull_requests.title: Clarify when to revisit Mirte for Furfrou Mission 087
pull_requests.finding: The complete hair/beauty guide and source research note are exact; conservative Mission087 revisit guidance is included.

pull_requests.title: AT-335 research — Distinguish Wild Zone 2’s two Great Balls
pull_requests.finding: Great Ball east/west disambiguation evidence is archived. It does not approve an exact pickup pin or a new collection identity.

pull_requests.title: AT-334 — Recover original Workspace item coordinates and crosswalk
pull_requests.finding: Alternate source-recovery documents and provenance are archived; do not overwrite the newer canonical recovery register or claim byte-identical duplicate source records.

pull_requests.title: Complete Side Mission 109’s medicine and cash rewards
pull_requests.finding: The complete Mission109 source card is byte-identical to the PR head and retained in generated and standalone views.

pull_requests.title: AT-322 — Corroborate Wild Zone 18’s ordinary roster with the original screenshot
pull_requests.finding: Both Zone18 source-review documents are exact blobs on main. Six displayed survey species do not certify an exhaustive roster or absence of disputed encounters.

pull_requests.title: AT-327 research — Cross-check Wild Zone 11’s southern edge with Vert 6
pull_requests.finding: The original southern-edge registration research is archived. Later selection-outline approval does not turn it into floor or spawn geometry.

pull_requests.title: AT-325 G2 — Verify the three historical owner overview photographs
pull_requests.finding: The three historical overview-photo records are archived with their limits; they remain distinct from later owner overview sources.

pull_requests.title: AT-320 — Bleu 7–10 written routes and photographic references
pull_requests.finding: All four Bleu7–10 added route objects, including their steps, are exactly retained among the current42 routes.

pull_requests.title: AT-297 — Record the original Workspace v37 release
pull_requests.finding: The original Workspace v37 release receipt is preserved. It is historical evidence, not proof of the newly released GitHub version being published to the original Workspace.

pull_requests.title: AT-266 — plan source-first recovery of original Workspace map close-ups
pull_requests.finding: Source recovery was superseded by later original-image recoveries; registration and uncertainty requirements remain preserved.

pull_requests.title: Atlas: owner-surveyed Holovator photo map (21 approximate research entries)
pull_requests.finding: The21-entry/90-photo prototype is superseded by the current Explorer21 Holovators and111 photo references; source policy and historical patch remain archived.

pull_requests.title: Draft: isolated visual research map for Holovator photo leads
pull_requests.finding: The older isolated research preview was superseded by the later owner fieldbook and Explorer. Its approximate-source evidence remains archived.

pull_requests.title: Fix 8 broken Rogue Mega Boss portraits using Pokémon HOME catalogue
pull_requests.finding: boss-guide.html is byte-identical to this PR head; the eight portrait repairs already reached main through later merged work.

pull_requests.title: Protect player progress: JSON backup, old-site exporter and safe import
pull_requests.finding: The backup/export/import runtime files are absent from exact main. This is the recorded optional migration backlog; original-host compatibility remains unverified.

pull_requests.title: Number Wild Zone map items and link them with tick lists
pull_requests.finding: map-numbering.js and map-pin-index.js are absent from exact main. The146 approximate numbering positions and111 candidate/35 ambiguous links remain archived/deferred, with existing collection identities preserved.

pull_requests.title: Expand early story missions 01–10 and connect guide sections
pull_requests.finding: Verified early-story route detail is incorporated:73 steps across Missions01–10, with matching lists in source, generated main guide and standalone walkthrough. Historical duplicate UI and unsupported claims were deliberately omitted.

pull_requests.title: Prepare Lumiose Atlas logo sharing card and safe IONOS subdomain
pull_requests.finding: Branding/social-card and optional IONOS hosting plans remain preserved future scope. No DNS, origin or Stream Bandit change is implied.

pull_requests.title: Audit: benchmark all 42 main missions and rebuild Mable's Research
pull_requests.finding: Mable recovery was superseded; the all42-mission depth and17-section audit obligations remain preserved and are not certified complete by Map2.0.

cleanup_boundaries: Do not merge stale branches wholesale or replace current canonical plans with older revisions.
Do not equate archived evidence with completed runtime delivery: PR4 numbering and PR5 backup/export remain separate unverified or optional candidates.
PR1 broader guide-depth audit, PR2 optional branding/hosting and original Workspace duties remain distinct from the finite Map2.0 release.
Archival source and current requirement dispositions must remain discoverable if an owner later closes superseded PRs. This review closes nothing.
